info.title: Deployed Angular v2 API
info.description: Exported from the deployed service without running its startup/lifespan. Contracts only; no business rows, keys or database connections. Deployed C++ API 0.6.1 and isolated Python handlers. Developer role: viewer, tenant 4. This credential does not authenticate to the main /api service. Frontend-only sandbox additions are not deployed here. See README for the tested compatibility matrix.
